mentions.name: Hiring platform for recruiters
mentions.description: A hiring platform that makes hiring simple and easy for recruiters while increasing job applicants' visibility when applying for a particular job.
mentions.problem: Hiring is complicated for recruiters, and job applicants lack visibility when applying for a particular job.
mentions.audience: Recruiters and job candidates/applicants applying for jobs
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a platform to make hiring simple and easy for recruiters.
Also, increasing candidates/job applicants visibility when applying for a particular job.

evidence.value:

Also, increasing candidates/job applicants visibility when applying for a particular job.
